function: Joint CSI feedback (deep joint source-channel coding of eigenvectors) and multiuser precoding with power allocation, trained end-to-end to maximize the downlink sum-rate (p. 1-3)
system: FDD MU-MIMO-OFDM, BS with Nt antennas, K=2 users with Nr antennas each (numbers not stated), no RIS; urban macrocell, 1.9 GHz downlink, 2.1 GHz uplink (p. 2, 4)
method: DJSCC convolutional encoder and decoder plus fully connected precoding and power-allocation modules; end-to-end training on the sum-rate objective with Adam, paradigm not named (p. 3-4)
data_channel: QuaDRiGa channels following 3GPP TR 38.901, urban macrocell, simulated uplink and downlink CSI; 100,000 training, 30,000 validation, 20,000 test samples (p. 4)
test_conditions: Trained on uplink SNR uniform in [-10,10] dB; tested over an SNR sweep and feedback sizes n=32 to 512; same UMa setting, random user locations (p. 4-5)
baselines: Non-learned: block diagonalization with water-filling on perfect feedback (PF_BD_WF) and on DJSCC-recovered CSI (DJSCC_BD_WF); learned: DJSCC network with recovered eigenvector used as precoder (p. 4)
metrics: Downlink sum-rate in bps/Hz versus uplink SNR and versus feedback overhead n, plus an ablation of the precoding and power-allocation modules (p. 4-5)
q1_support: p. 4: "The uplink CSI and the downlink CSI are generated by QuaDRiGa [12], following the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) TR 38.901 [13]."
q2_support: p. 5: "The trained networks are evaluated at test SNRs of -10 dB, 0 dB and 10 dB." Not met: only SNR and feedback-overhead sweeps in the same urban macrocell setting; no new scenario, band, user number or antenna configuration.
q3_support: p. 4: "the JFPNet demonstrates a superior downlink sum-rate in comparison to the other methods." Fig. 2 compares with PF_BD_WF (non-learned) and with DJSCC (learned), on sum-rate.
q4_support: p. 5: "our method achieves a superior downlink sum-rate" is the only outcome reported. Not met: no order of complexity, FLOPs, parameter count or runtime; the feedback overhead n is signaling and does not count.
q5_support: p. 4: "Training, validation, and test datasets contain 100,000, 30,000, and 20,000 sample pairs" generated with QuaDRiGa; no code or data link or DOI anywhere in the paper.
notes: Preprint arXiv 2404.16289v1 of a TVT correspondence. Area 3 rather than 2: the method solves feedback (area 2) and precoding (area 3) jointly, and the main metric is the downlink sum-rate. q3 caveat for the reviewer: the learned baseline DJSCC is the DJSCC feedback network that the introduction attributes to [6] (overlapping authors), trained with MSE and used directly as precoder (p. 4); the paper does not cite [6] at the baseline definition, and it could be read as the proposed network without its JMP and PA modules, so confirm. The ablation (w/o JMP, w/o PA, p. 4) is separate and was not used for q3. Nt and Nr values are not stated numerically.
